components.name: Notched Text Field
components.description: Permanent 12/16px label in a real top-border notch, shared by FluentTextInput and native password/passphrase, multiline, number and date/time inputs. One delegated focus indicator; translucent Fluent material and 4px corners. The visible border box is the layout box: explicit 24/32/40px desktop sizes and 44px coarse-pointer targets for ordinary fields. Only date/time fields add 4px of content clearance on each block side, producing 32/40/48px desktop sizes and 52px touch targets; the label overhangs by 8px and never adds control height. Multiline fields retain their existing padding; inline actions match the field height while standalone buttons retain their density. Native date/time picker icons align at the inline end with one layer of horizontal padding and theme-native colors.
components.html: Password
components.css: .ds-field { --ds-field-size:32px; position:relative; height:fit-content; border-radius:4px; font:14px/20px "Noto Sans", "Noto Sans SC", sans-serif; } .ds-field:has(input:is([type="date"], [type="time"], [type="datetime-local"])) { --ds-field-extra:8px; } .ds-field label { position:absolute; top:-8px; left:12px; font:12px/16px "Noto Sans", "Noto Sans SC", sans-serif; } .ds-field-content { box-sizing:border-box; display:flex; align-items:center; min-height:calc(var(--ds-field-size) + var(--ds-field-extra, 0px)); border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:inherit; background:var(--cfms-field-background, #fff); } .ds-field input { box-sizing:border-box; width:100%; height:calc(var(--ds-field-size) + var(--ds-field-extra, 0px) - 2px); border:0; padding:0 12px; background:transparent; color:var(--colorNeutralForeground1, #242424); } .ds-field fieldset { position:absolute; inset:-8px 0 0; margin:0; padding:0; border:1px solid var(--colorNeutralStroke1, #d1d1d1); border-radius:inherit; pointer-events:none; } .ds-field legend { margin-left:8px; padding:0 4px; font:12px/16px "Noto Sans", "Noto Sans SC", sans-serif; } .ds-field legend span { visibility:hidden; } .ds-field:focus-within fieldset { border-color:var(--colorStrokeFocus2, #0067c0); border-bottom-width:2px; } @media (pointer:coarse) { .ds-field { --ds-field-size:44px; } .ds-field input { font-size:16px; } }

narrative.overview: Windows 11 hierarchy with Fluent 2 controls and bundled Noto typography across desktop and Android. A shared confirmed Mica workspace base with an opaque fallback, settings entries in two columns at workspace widths of 800px and above with side-by-side copy and status at entry widths of 360px and above, explicit selected radio dots, regular explorer commands, and an integrated server search field share the foundations; complex lists and editors preserve their workflows.
keyCharacteristics: Native UI typography and compact working density.
Semantic Fluent themes and local system icons.
Native Windows Mica across persistent chrome and workspace, with 60% content and 55% field materials above it.
Shared menus, file-search previews and dialogs use 94% neutral tint with 20px blur and 1.2 saturation, solid accessibility fallbacks and Smoke modal dimming.
Preserved circular fluid connection action and authentication image transition.

rules.name: One Theme Authority
rules.body: Runtime theme objects own values; legacy variables are aliases only.

rules.name: Material Has a Job
rules.body: Confirmed Mica is shared by persistent chrome and the full workspace base, including file navigation, commands and status, with an opaque fallback, 60% content material and 55% field material. Shared menus, file-search previews and dialogs use cfms-acrylic-surface with 94% neutral tint, 20px blur, 1.2 saturation and Fluent stroke/shadow; unsupported blur, reduced transparency and forced colors use solid surfaces. File address/search outer heights are 32px desktop and 44px coarse pointer. Address breadcrumbs collapse distant ancestors into a nearest-first context menu for all servers, keeping the current directory visible with full-name tooltips for ellipsized names. Reserve 32px desktop or 44px coarse-pointer blank space at the right; with node_lookup any blank space enters editing and selects the known path, retaining Alt+D/F4 without a pencil icon. At extreme widths root also moves into the menu. Other breadcrumb consumers retain their existing layout. The toolbar says Search in {directory} while preserving server-wide search; the search dialog retains its explicit server-wide placeholder. Smoke dims blocking dialogs on a separately animated sibling layer. Content/field filters paint on pseudo-elements; viewport dialogs and context menus mount at the document body. File navigation adds a per-server/account session history with Alt+Left/Right and keeps Refresh after Search.

rules.name: Sensitive Fields Stay Native
rules.body: Never send a password or private-key passphrase to a reflecting custom text input.

rules.name: Preserve Signature Motion
rules.body: Keep circular connection feedback and the 600ms authentication choreography, with reduced-motion end states.

dos: Use Fluent across platforms and adapt input targets.
Keep security and bilingual copy unchanged.

Do not replace business behavior for appearance.
